_readme: Backend CONNECTION config: which LLM backend, where it lives, and which data files to use.
Everything that shapes the model's OUTPUT — temperature, numPredict, topK/topP/minP,
penalties, retry behaviour — lives in config/tuning.json (section 'translation'), so there
is exactly ONE file to tune. Leaving an old copy of those keys here does nothing; the app
warns about each one on startup.
auto: '/v1' -> openai, ':11434' or '/api' -> ollama, else llama.cpp '/completion'.
baseUrl        : backend base URL. Use '.../v1' for the OpenAI chat endpoint (recommended for
Qwen3, so the chat template applies).
model          : leave empty to auto-discover (openai/ollama). llama.cpp ignores it when only
sourceLanguage : language to read at startup, 'zh' or 'en'. Only a default — the language
picked from the capture window's right-click menu is remembered and wins.
glossaryFileZh : glossary used when the source is Chinese; glossaryFileEn when it is English.
The active one follows the selected source language.
